summary: Authorized adversary engagement intake, scope boundary validation, and immutable execution planning.
limitations: Operator authorization and rules of engagement envelope are required before executing plans.
Only non-destructive, bounded assessment actions are modeled.
Active live execution is refused when assessment window, emergency contact, or budget limits are incomplete.
Network egress is prohibited outside explicitly approved live execution scopes.

demo.description: Run the planning-only engagement playback through a local inert subprocess and write validated evidence artifacts without network requests.
